Welcome & Opening Remarks
Keynote Address

The Next Era of Smart Manufacturing and the Connected Toolroom

Inside a Modern Toolroom: Lessons in Precision, Process Control, and Scalable Efficiency

The Smart Factory Next Door

11:00 am – 12:00 pm

Roadmapping Efficiency – ZOLLER System Strategy - Start with a Solution. Enter a System.

The Roadmap to a Fully Connected Toolroom and efficiency manufacturing process
How ZOLLER solutions create a closed-loop system from tool preparation to the CNC machine.

Topics include:

  • Digital tool data flow
  • Tool inspection and verification
  • Automated tool management
  • Reducing scrap and increasing spindle uptime

12:00 pm - 01:00 pm
Lunch - German Cuisine

  • Traditional German lunch and networking with ZOLLER experts

01:00 pm - 02:30 pm
Breakout Sessions - Round 1

Track 1 – User Track (TMS & Practical Implementation)
Optimizing Tool Management with ZOLLER TMS

  • Managing tool data and assemblies
  • Integrating presetting with CAM and CNC
  • Tool lifecycle management
  • Best practices from successful ZOLLER users

Track 2 – Executive Track
Manufacturing Outlook & ROI of Digital Tool Management

  • Industry trends in aerospace and precision manufacturing – guest speaker – Aerospace Design and Engineering or AMT Forecasting
  • The ROI of integrated tool management systems
  • Reducing cost per part through data-driven tooling strategies

Track 3 – Inspiration Track
Automation in the Toolroom

  • Automated tool management workflows
  • Lights-out toolroom/manufacturing strategies
  • Integrating automation into your shop floor

Building a Business Case for Smart Toolrooms

Track 3 – Inspiration Track
From Toolroom to Smart Factory

  • Connected manufacturing ecosystems

  • Preparing your organization for the next stage of digital manufacturing
